title: Search stopped working
body:
We used to use this app on daily basis within the family for having shared lists, eg shopping list, items listed for a vacation to pack, etc. 
The fact that each List did not have their own search function always bothered me but at least the one on the main page worked, I did not complain. Now, it stopped working. I am having the latest ios, even restarted my phone (which is a normal “solution” for things on a Windows, but not here.) At least I can confirm restart is not a solution. It got even worse actually. I tried the search and showes nothing. When I stepped into our shopping list, than back, some part of the functions returned, but atill not showing all the items that are mathing for my search. Which means, that if I am willing to select an item, I have to scroll and find it in a list that has roughly 3-500 items. Lovely, isn’t it?

UPDATE: chatgpt helped. I needed to switch off something, switch the phone off than on again, switch on again something related to appsearch, wait for re-indexing and now it works. However,  ot changing my rating. My expectation is that it works on its own. Or at least instructions are available easily!!

title: The “Reminders” App Issues
body:
Occasionally, a completed task cannot be marked as done because its status automatically and immediately reverts to incomplete. This happens quite frequently. Another issue is that I abandoned this app many years ago because tasks I had entered were deleted and lost. That happened around 10 years ago, and since then, I hadn’t trusted the app—until now. About six months ago, I decided to give it another try and started using it again. I was pleased to see many great improvements had been made since I last used it. Unfortunately, two days ago, the same anomaly occurred again. Specifically, I had prepared several dozen subtasks for an upcoming trip to ensure I wouldn’t miss anything important related to my travel. However, I noticed that most of the subtasks had been spontaneously deleted and could not be recovered. Interestingly, not all subtasks were deleted; about 10 remained, roughly split 50-50 between completed and incomplete ones.

Now, I am at the point where, if this happens one more time, I will stop using the software again. Before making that decision, I thought I would share my experiences, hoping it might contribute to improving the app. I would gladly welcome any feedback.
